# Nakama runtime definitions

`index.d.ts` and `LICENSE` are unmodified files from Heroic Labs
[`nakama-common` v1.44.2](https://github.com/heroiclabs/nakama-common/tree/v1.44.2).
This is the exact version referenced by Nakama **v3.37.0** in its `go.mod`.
Vendored as development-only type definitions; no Node modules are loaded by
the Nakama JavaScript runtime. Preserve the Apache-2.0 license when updating.
